name: jev.escalation
description: Level 1 single decision: does this need System-2 or is one typed judgment enough.

criteria.yes: The request contains: design, plan, architect, diagnose a root cause, explain why, draft new content, synthesize across multiple sources, or decide a tradeoff.
criteria.no: The request is one of: read a value, list files, a one-command status check, yes/no about a visible fact, parse a format, route one item to a category.

rules.reason: needs System 2: send to a reasoning model
not sure one typed judgment is enough: send to System 2

notes.verdicts: PASS = one Jev judgment is enough (needs_reasoning=no above 0.90). ESCALATE = send to a System-2 model (yes >= 0.5, or no at/below 0.90). Never BLOCKs.
notes.bar: Required answer must be ABOVE 0.90; exactly 0.90 does not pass (work-criteria.json).
notes.changed: 2026-09-28: rules rewritten; prior rules referenced a missing question (compact-read), used unsupported choice<0.90 (triage, skill-router), or were absent (escalation, auto-approve, file-triage).
